PrisonerInteractionModeDef.label: in-body cell
PrisonerInteractionModeDef.description: A capable colonist will transfer the prisoner into their body and keep them stored there with non-lethal storage vore. The prisoner's bed is freed once they are inside.

PrisonerInteractionModeDef.label: conversion material
PrisonerInteractionModeDef.description: A capable colonist will swallow the prisoner and convert them into vore product with a conversion goal (lubrify, lactify, spermify, ...). This is fatal: the prisoner will not survive.
